description: TECH PUBLIC FS8205A — dual N-channel MOSFET, 20 V / 6 A, SOT-23-6. Source-tied internal back-to-back FET pair. The de-facto switch IC paired with DW01A for single-cell Li-ion/LiPo protection — together they make the cheap LiPo BMS found in nearly every Chinese power bank.
name: fs8205a
watch_out_for: NOT a general-purpose dual NFET — the internal sources are tied together (back-to-back drain-source-source-drain layout), so you can't use it for two independent low-side switches. The arrangement blocks reverse current through one body diode regardless of charge/discharge direction. Pair with DW01A (or a stacked-cell equivalent). Rds(on) is ~25 mΩ per FET so the cell's safe discharge current is limited not by the FET breakdown (20 V) but by I²R heating and the controller's overcurrent trip threshold.
